ConfigJSON.title: Settings
ConfigJSON.description: Settings config.json as a JSON string. Legacy combined configuration is also supported.

RulesJSON.title: Redirect rules
RulesJSON.description: rules.json as a JSON string. Overrides packaged and legacy combined rules.

AllowUserChanges.title: Allow user changes
AllowUserChanges.description: Whether users may change redirect settings. Overrides allowUserChanges.

AllowCustomRules.title: Allow custom rules
AllowCustomRules.description: Whether users may create, edit, import and use personal custom rules.
